name: Fig: The Game for Depression
storyline:
In Fig: The Game for Depression, players explore the peaceful world of Seedaria alongside Fig, a friendly digital companion designed to support mental well-being. As players reflect on their daily emotions, build healthy habits, and complete small mindful activities, the world around Fig gradually grows and evolves.

Through journaling, mood tracking, and routine building, players help restore balance to Seedaria while learning positive habits in their own lives. Fig acts as a supportive guide throughout the journey, encouraging reflection, mindfulness, and personal growth.
summary:
Fig: The Game for Depression is a mobile well-being game developed by Mindforce Game Lab.
The game combines positive psychology, cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) principles, and habit-building mechanics to help players improve their mental health.

Players explore the world of Seedaria alongside their digital companion Fig while completing daily activities such as journaling, mood tracking, habit building, and reflection. Progress in real life helps develop and expand the in-game world.

Fig is designed as a supportive companion experience that encourages healthy routines, mindfulness, and emotional awareness through interactive gameplay systems.
